entries.name: Attack vectors knowledge base (English)
entries.description: 349 attack vectors and CVEs across web applications, APIs, internal and external networks, Active Directory, cloud, mobile, wireless, social engineering, physical, endpoint and AI/LLM — with default severity, description, impact, test approach, remediation and detection note, mapped to OWASP Top 10 2025, OWASP API Top 10, WSTG, ASVS 5.0, MITRE ATT&CK, CWE, PayloadsAllTheThings, OSCP+ modules, CISSP domains and CISA KEV.

entries.name: Attack vectors knowledge base (Nederlands)
entries.description: Dezelfde 349 aanvalsvectoren en CVE's met Nederlandse rapporttekst (beschrijving, impact, testaanpak, remediatie en detectienotitie); de mappings naar OWASP, WSTG, ASVS, MITRE ATT&CK, CWE en CISA KEV zijn gelijk aan de Engelse versie.
